task.description: Validate the CODE-DESIGNER artefact at src/design/tnt-01-04-schema-isolation.md against all acceptance criteria for TNT-01, TNT-02, TNT-03, and TNT-04. This is a hard gate — BACKEND-DEV cannot start until this returns PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in TNT-01, TNT-02, TNT-03, TNT-04 has a corresponding design element
No implementation code (function bodies, SQL DDL) is present in the design artefact
All public function signatures modified or added are listed
Error taxonomy covers all new failure modes across TNT-01 through TNT-04
Migration runner search_path protocol is precisely specified
Connection pool checkout/return lifecycle is fully specified
Startup audit logic is specified with permitted table list
CI linter business-table pattern list is enumerated
python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/tnt-01-04-schema-isolation.md exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/tnt-01-04-schema-isolation.md validated against all acceptance criteria for TNT-01, TNT-02, TNT-03, and TNT-04. The BLOCKER from the first validation pass (TNT-03 no-tenant case unspecified) is confirmed fixed: the design now contains an explicit 'No-tenant case' section specifying that when tenant_id is empty/absent, applyRequestTenantContext issues SET search_path TO public only, does not prepend a tenant schema, does not call schemaNameForTenant, and does not issue set_config calls. All 21 business tables are covered in the CI linter pattern. The permitted public table list (10 tables) matches TNT-04. The migration runner search_path protocol specifies the exact SQL statement (SET search_path TO <schema_name>,public), its position (first statement, before schema_migrations check), and the one-connection-per-runForSchema contract. The connection pool lifecycle (checkout, reset-failure-discard, reconnect re-apply) is fully specified. The startup audit query uses table_schema='public' and table_type IN ('BASE TABLE','VIEW'), matching the TNT-04 edge case. python tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 with BLOCKER=0, MAJOR=0, MINOR=23 (all E030 schema-qualified names in design prose — expected and correct for a document describing the qualification protocol).
